Henry James, The Wings of the Dove.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/henry-james/the-wings-of-the-dove

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Henry James, the author and the writer of the preface, died 1916 (Wikidata Q170509, date of death 1916-02-28).

First publication of the text used: 1902 (SE colophon: 'The Wings of the Dove was published in 1902 by Henry James.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1902, before 1931. The edition's own statement of rights, quoted below, says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication of the text, which the facts do not name): the last person to die among those named above died in 1916. So the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, and the country does not matter.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: first publication 1902 (quoted above).
- Wikidata Q170509 (Henry James), P570 = 1916-02-28.
